name: finance-management
description: Finora personal finance: web (React + Express + PostgreSQL) and offline desktop/mobile apps (Electron/Capacitor + SQLite) sharing one core

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @finora/core && concurrently -k -n core,server,client -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w @finora/core" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @finora/core && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @finora/core && npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w @finora/core && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
